#!/bin/sh
cd "${0%/*}" || exit 1
. ${WM_PROJECT_DIR:?}/bin/tools/RunFunctions
# Generated for OpenFOAM 14 (Foundation) — solver: simpleFoam
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Remove Windows download markers (harmless, but clutter the case)
find . -name '*:Zone.Identifier' -delete 2>/dev/null

# ── Mesh: convert only if no polyMesh exists yet ──
if [ ! -f constant/polyMesh/faces ] && [ ! -f constant/polyMesh/faces.gz ]
then
    MSH=$(ls *.msh 2>/dev/null | head -1)
    if [ -n "$MSH" ]
    then
        runApplication fluent3DMeshToFoam "$MSH"
    elif [ -f system/blockMeshDict ]
    then
        runApplication blockMesh
    else
        echo "No mesh: put a Fluent .msh in the case folder or a polyMesh in constant/polyMesh"
        exit 1
    fi
fi

runApplication checkMesh

# ── Mesh quality gate (FORCE=1 ./Allrun to override) ──
if grep -q "Failed [0-9]* mesh checks" log.checkMesh && [ -z "$FORCE" ]
then
    echo "checkMesh reported failed checks (see log.checkMesh). Fix the mesh or run: FORCE=1 ./Allrun"
    exit 1
fi
NONORTH=$(sed -n 's/.*non-orthogonality Max: *\([0-9.eE+-]*\).*/\1/p' log.checkMesh | head -1)
NCORR=$(awk -v n="${NONORTH:-0}" 'BEGIN{print (n>80)?3:(n>70)?2:(n>60)?1:0}')
if [ "$NCORR" -gt 0 ]
then
    echo "max non-orthogonality $NONORTH deg -> nNonOrthogonalCorrectors $NCORR, limited schemes"
    for d in system
    do
        for a in SIMPLE PIMPLE PISO; do foamDictionary $d/fvSolution -entry $a/nNonOrthogonalCorrectors -set $NCORR >/dev/null 2>&1; done
        foamDictionary $d/fvSchemes -entry laplacianSchemes/default -set "Gauss linear limited corrected 0.33" >/dev/null 2>&1
        foamDictionary $d/fvSchemes -entry snGradSchemes/default -set "limited corrected 0.33" >/dev/null 2>&1
    done
fi

runApplication $(getApplication)

# ── y+ check against the chosen wall treatment (30-300) ──
YP=$(ls -t postProcessing/yPlus/*/yPlus*.dat 2>/dev/null | head -1)
if [ -n "$YP" ]
then
    LAST=$(grep -v '^#' "$YP" | awk 'NF{t=$1} END{print t}')
    grep -v '^#' "$YP" | awk -v t="$LAST" -v lo=30 -v hi=300 '$1==t && NF>=5 {
        printf "y+ %-20s min %8.3g  max %8.3g  avg %8.3g", $2, $3, $4, $5
        if ($5<lo || $5>hi) printf "   <-- outside %g-%g: refine/coarsen first cell or switch wall treatment", lo, hi
        printf "\n" }' | tee log.yPlusCheck
fi

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Turbomachinery performance from OpenFOAM postProcessing output.

Reads the last sample of turboForces / turboInlet / turboOutlet / turboFlow and prints
torque, power, total-pressure rise, head and hydraulic efficiency:

    dp0  = (p + 0.5*rho*|U|^2)_out - (p + 0.5*rho*|U|^2)_in
    H    = dp0 / (rho*g)
    eta  = Q*dp0 / (T*omega)   (pump/fan)   — inverse for turbines

Incompressible solvers report kinematic p (p/rho); it is scaled by rho here.
"""
import glob, math, os, re, sys

RHO = 1.225
OMEGA = 104.719755          # rad/s (1000 rpm)
AXIS = [0,0,1]
KINEMATIC_P = True


def last_row(name, pattern):
    files = sorted(glob.glob(os.path.join("postProcessing", name, "*", pattern)), key=os.path.getmtime)
    if not files:
        return None
    for line in reversed(open(files[-1]).read().splitlines()):
        if line.strip() and not line.startswith("#"):
            return [float(x) for x in re.findall(r"-?\d+\.?\d*(?:[eE][-+]?\d+)?", line)]
    return None


def stagnation(row):
    # row = time, p, Ux, Uy, Uz
    p = row[1] * (RHO if KINEMATIC_P else 1.0)
    return p + 0.5 * RHO * (row[2] ** 2 + row[3] ** 2 + row[4] ** 2)


mom = last_row("turboForces", "mom*.dat")      # ESI: time total(xyz) pressure(xyz) viscous(xyz)
if mom is not None:
    M = mom[1:4]
else:                                           # Foundation: time ((Fp)(Fv)) ((Mp)(Mv))
    f = last_row("turboForces", "forces.dat")
    if f is None or len(f) < 13:
        sys.exit("no turboForces output found — run the solver first")
    M = [f[7 + i] + f[10 + i] for i in range(3)]
n = math.sqrt(sum(a * a for a in AXIS)) or 1.0
torque = sum(m * a / n for m, a in zip(M, AXIS))
power = torque * OMEGA
print(f"Torque about axis : {torque:12.5g} N.m")
print(f"Shaft power       : {power:12.5g} W")

pin, pout, flow = last_row("turboInlet", "*.dat"), last_row("turboOutlet", "*.dat"), last_row("turboFlow", "*.dat")
if pin and pout and len(pin) >= 5 and len(pout) >= 5:
    dp0 = stagnation(pout) - stagnation(pin)
    print(f"Total-pressure rise: {dp0:12.5g} Pa")
    print(f"Head              : {dp0 / (RHO * 9.80665):12.5g} m")
    if flow:
        Q = abs(flow[1]) / (1.0 if KINEMATIC_P else RHO)
        print(f"Volume flow rate  : {Q:12.5g} m3/s")
        if abs(power) > 0:
            eta = Q * dp0 / abs(power)
            print(f"Efficiency        : {eta if eta <= 1 else 1 / eta:12.4f}  (pump: Q*dp0/P, turbine: P/(Q*dp0))")

#!/bin/sh
cd "${0%/*}" || exit 1
. ${WM_PROJECT_DIR:?}/bin/tools/RunFunctions
# Generated for OpenFOAM 14 (Foundation) — solver: simpleFoam
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Remove Windows download markers (harmless, but clutter the case)
find . -name '*:Zone.Identifier' -delete 2>/dev/null

# ── Mesh: convert only if no polyMesh exists yet ──
if [ ! -f constant/polyMesh/faces ] && [ ! -f constant/polyMesh/faces.gz ]
then
    MSH=$(ls *.msh 2>/dev/null | head -1)
    if [ -n "$MSH" ]
    then
        runApplication fluentMeshToFoam "$MSH"
    elif [ -f system/blockMeshDict ]
    then
        runApplication blockMesh
    else
        echo "No mesh: put a Fluent .msh in the case folder or a polyMesh in constant/polyMesh"
        exit 1
    fi
fi

runApplication checkMesh

# ── Mesh quality gate (FORCE=1 ./Allrun to override) ──
if grep -q "Failed [0-9]* mesh checks" log.checkMesh && [ -z "$FORCE" ]
then
    echo "checkMesh reported failed checks (see log.checkMesh). Fix the mesh or run: FORCE=1 ./Allrun"
    exit 1
fi
NONORTH=$(sed -n 's/.*non-orthogonality Max: *\([0-9.eE+-]*\).*/\1/p' log.checkMesh | head -1)
NCORR=$(awk -v n="${NONORTH:-0}" 'BEGIN{print (n>80)?3:(n>70)?2:(n>60)?1:0}')
if [ "$NCORR" -gt 0 ]
then
    echo "max non-orthogonality $NONORTH deg -> nNonOrthogonalCorrectors $NCORR, limited schemes"
    for d in system
    do
        for a in SIMPLE PIMPLE PISO; do foamDictionary $d/fvSolution -entry $a/nNonOrthogonalCorrectors -set $NCORR >/dev/null 2>&1; done
        foamDictionary $d/fvSchemes -entry laplacianSchemes/default -set "Gauss linear limited corrected 0.33" >/dev/null 2>&1
        foamDictionary $d/fvSchemes -entry snGradSchemes/default -set "limited corrected 0.33" >/dev/null 2>&1

fi

runApplication $(getApplication)

        if ($5<lo || $5>hi) printf "   <-- outside %g-%g: refine/coarsen first cell or switch wall treatment", lo, hi
        printf "\n" }' | tee log.yPlusCheck

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Turbomachinery performance from OpenFOAM postProcessing output.

Reads the last sample of turboForces / turboInlet / turboOutlet / turboFlow and prints
torque, power, total-pressure rise, head and hydraulic efficiency:

    dp0  = (p + 0.5*rho*|U|^2)_out - (p + 0.5*rho*|U|^2)_in
    H    = dp0 / (rho*g)
    eta  = Q*dp0 / (T*omega)   (pump/fan)   — inverse for turbines

Incompressible solvers report kinematic p (p/rho); it is scaled by rho here.
"""
import glob, math, os, re, sys

RHO = 1.225
OMEGA = 104.719755          # rad/s (1000 rpm)
AXIS = [0,0,1]
KINEMATIC_P = True


def last_row(name, pattern):
    files = sorted(glob.glob(os.path.join("postProcessing", name, "*", pattern)), key=os.path.getmtime)
    if not files:
        return None
    for line in reversed(open(files[-1]).read().splitlines()):
        if line.strip() and not line.startswith("#"):
            return [float(x) for x in re.findall(r"-?\d+\.?\d*(?:[eE][-+]?\d+)?", line)]
    return None


def stagnation(row):
    # row = time, p, Ux, Uy, Uz
    p = row[1] * (RHO if KINEMATIC_P else 1.0)
    return p + 0.5 * RHO * (row[2] ** 2 + row[3] ** 2 + row[4] ** 2)


mom = last_row("turboForces", "mom*.dat")      # ESI: time total(xyz) pressure(xyz) viscous(xyz)
if mom is not None:
    M = mom[1:4]
else:                                           # Foundation: time ((Fp)(Fv)) ((Mp)(Mv))
    f = last_row("turboForces", "forces.dat")
    if f is None or len(f) < 13:
        sys.exit("no turboForces output found — run the solver first")
    M = [f[7 + i] + f[10 + i] for i in range(3)]
n = math.sqrt(sum(a * a for a in AXIS)) or 1.0
torque = sum(m * a / n for m, a in zip(M, AXIS))
power = torque * OMEGA
print(f"Torque about axis : {torque:12.5g} N.m")
print(f"Shaft power       : {power:12.5g} W")

pin, pout, flow = last_row("turboInlet", "*.dat"), last_row("turboOutlet", "*.dat"), last_row("turboFlow", "*.dat")
if pin and pout and len(pin) >= 5 and len(pout) >= 5:
    dp0 = stagnation(pout) - stagnation(pin)
    print(f"Total-pressure rise: {dp0:12.5g} Pa")
    print(f"Head              : {dp0 / (RHO * 9.80665):12.5g} m")
    if flow:
        Q = abs(flow[1]) / (1.0 if KINEMATIC_P else RHO)
        print(f"Volume flow rate  : {Q:12.5g} m3/s")
        if abs(power) > 0:
            eta = Q * dp0 / abs(power)
            print(f"Efficiency        : {eta if eta <= 1 else 1 / eta:12.4f}  (pump: Q*dp0/P, turbine: P/(Q*dp0))")
